text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan trained late into the night in 
preparation for the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, she bumped into Ines Fujin, who 
was also working hard practicing late into 
the evening.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She firmly stated that in the next race, 
she would make Mejiro Ryan—whose eyes were 
glued to Mejiro McQueen—turn and look at 
her without fail.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan felt uneasy about competing 
against her close friend.
